Date is the primary report date; exact ceremony day is not asserted. This supports the opened facility, without claiming a capacity, occupancy or later operating milestone.

additions.successor_review: Bounded searches for Telconet Cloud Center III and September/October 2026, operator news indexes and the currently captured official company feed found later visits and cloud-service promotion, with no closure, withdrawal or contradictory physical status. The earlier 25 August company release remains visible in web search but its origin timed out; it is not the selected raw status source. No date is renewed from later promotional material.

additions.distinctness_review: Checked all five hundredthird base files (847 sites, 915 projects), every tracked holds file, and available local changes/holds fragments (90 files). No matching baseline site or source identity. See dedupe-review.json for paths, aliases, historical hold matches and nearest-site distances. Boreal, Keephills, TransAlta and Sundance are absent from the base. The proposed land south of Keephills Generating Station is distinct from the existing generating plant, Sundance plant and the public meeting hall. Potential future phases on Sections 24 and 13 do not create extra sites or projects.

locator.identity_review: Presentation page 3 gives Section 25-51-4-W5M for Phase 1. Page 10 visually labels its four quarters and shades the NW quarter green inside the proposed Phase 1 grading area. Official Alberta ATS query returns land OBJECTID 664290 and a separate road allowance 541403; only the land feature is used. Its longitude/latitude bounding-box midpoint is inside the land polygon and the central green NW area. The point is a vector-derived interior reference with compiled authority, not a source-published point or surveyed project boundary.
locator.precision: Interior point of NW quarter Section 25-51-4-W5M, which the developer highlights within the proposed Phase 1 area. Locates the proposed land, not an exact data-centre building or campus boundary. Neither the full section nor a power-station or community-hall address is used.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The official ATS geometry has no supplied positional-accuracy estimate; the developer map is conceptual and does not identify individual data-centre buildings. Numeric precision is not a measured campus-position accuracy.

status.summary: The dated 7 October 2026 developer open-house presentation identifies the proposed Boreal Phase 1 data-processing facility on part of Section 25-51-4-W5M. Its grading and development-permit steps are prospective. The 2025 zoning changes and initial grid allocation do not establish a data-centre development permit, physical works or operational capacity.

additions.successor_review: Current developer and county pages, checked on 28 October 2026, continue to describe future development-permit stages and further information sessions. The project page confirms the 7 October open house occurred. Bounded searches found no issued data-centre development permit or physical construction report superseding the 7 October proposal. Proposed grading schedules and a separate power-plant repowering approval are not data-centre construction.
